end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Discussed cone features: pointed tip and circular base.
Identified that a cylinder has two flat faces, at the top and bottom.
Aditya corrected the idea that turning a cone upside down changes its shape.
Teach-back was not passed; several shape names remained unanswered.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying 3D shapes through their features and views. They described a cone’s pointed tip and circular base, and used the top-and-bottom faces to discuss a cylinder. There was a mix-up about whether turning a cone changes its shape, which they corrected later by explaining that it remains a cone. At home, you can name shapes in everyday objects and ask Aditya to describe one feature of each.
